sn35.94:3.1: saḷeva → chaḷeva (bj, sya-all, pts) | bhikkhavo → bhikkhave (sya-all) | Saḷeva → chaḷeva (cck: ka.)
sn35.94:3.2: dukkhaṁ → dukkhahaṁ (pts) | dukkhahaṁ → B2 sukhaṁ (pts note)

sn35.94:4.2: athopi disvāna → atho pi disvā (pts) | amanoramāni → S1-3 manopamāni (pts note)
sn35.94:4.4: cāppiyaṁ → cappiyaṁ (bj) | na cāppiyaṁ meti → nacappiyam me ti (pts) | cappiyaṁ → na cāppiyaṁ (bj: syā, machasaṁ) | nacappiyam → S1-3 nacāppiyam here and further on (pts note)
sn35.94:5.1: dubhayaṁ → dutiyaṁ (sya-all, pts) | dutiyam → S1-3 dihayaṁ (pts note)
sn35.94:5.2: samucchito → S3 pamucchito; B2 sumuñcito (pts note)
sn35.94:5.4: cāppiyaṁ meti manaṁ → cappiyam me ti manam (pts)
sn35.94:6.2: ghatvā → ghātvā (bj) | athopi ghatvā asuciṁ → atho pi ghātvā asucim (pts)
sn35.94:7.1: bhotvāna asāditañca → bhotvā sāditañca (bj) | bhotvāna asāditañca sāduṁ → bhotvā paritaṁ ca sādu (sya-all) | sāduṁ → paritañca sādu (bj: syā); sāditañcasāduṁ (bj: sī.pavi); asāditañca sāduṁ (bj: machasaṁ); sāditañcasāduñca (bj: sīmu)

sn35.94:7.4: asādūsu → S3 asādhusū; B2 āyādūsu; B1 āsāduma (pts note)
sn35.94:8.1: majje → majjhe (bj: syā, sī.pavi) | majje → majjhe (cck: syā. kaṁ. pī.) | phuṭṭho → B2 phuṭṭhe (pts note) | majje → S3 majjhena (pts note)
sn35.94:8.3: sukhadukkhe → sukhadukkhaṁ (sya-all) | upekkhe → upekho (pts) | sukhadukkhe → sukhadukkhaṁ (bj: syā) | upekkhe → upekkho (bj: sīmu) | upekho → B1-2 upekkhe (pts note)
sn35.94:9.4: irīyati → hi iriyati (sya-all) | nekkhammasitam → B2 nikkhamma-; S1-3 -sitaṁhi (pts note) | irīyati → B2 iriyati; S1-3 iriyatīti (pts note)
sn35.94:10.2: phuṭṭhassa → S3 phuṭṭhassu (pts note) | vikampate → S1 vikampite; S3 vikampaṇe (pts note)
sn35.94:10.3: rāgadose → rāgadosaṁ hi (sya-all) | rāgadose → rāgadosaṁ (bj: sīmu) | rāgadose → S1-3 rāgadosaṁ; B1-3 add hi (pts note)
sn35.94:10.4: bhavattha → bhavātha (bj) | pāragāti paṭhamaṁ → pāragā ti (pts) | bhavātha → bhavattha (bj: machasaṁ) | Bhavattha → bhavatha (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ.) | bhavattha → So B1; B2 bhavata; S1-3 bhavā (pts note)
